name: Hand-painted texture
summary: Mid-poly models with textures painted by hand: light, shadow, wear and colour shifts are in the paint, not in the engine. Chunky, exaggerated buildings and bright, saturated colour read clearly at a distance.

philosophy.core_thesis: A painter's hand can carry the light of a world, so a small engine budget still gives a warm, rich place.
design_principles: Paint light from above into each texture: lighter top edges, darker bottoms.
Exaggerate shapes: thick walls, big beams, crooked roofs.
Use saturated, warm colours with cool hue-shifted shadows.
Paint edge wear as bright strokes on corners.
Keep the polygon count moderate and the silhouette strong.
Avoid photo sources; every pixel of texture is painted.

projection_and_camera.camera: Free orbit camera behind the player.
projection_and_camera.framing: Wide vistas with landmarks; the player small in a big world.

geometry.primitive: A mid-poly mesh with chunky bevels.
geometry.budget: 2,000–10,000 triangles for a character; buildings in modular sets.
geometry.edge_rule: Soft silhouettes with bevelled, chunky edges.
geometry.proportion: Exaggerated and heroic: big shoulders, oversized doors and lanterns.

surface.texture_rule: Diffuse-only textures painted by hand with light, shadow and wear in them.
surface.material_model: Diffuse only, or a simple specular; light is mostly in the paint.

palette.strategy: Warm, saturated hues; shadows shift to purple or blue, highlights to yellow.

lighting.model: Simple dynamic light on top of the light painted into textures.
lighting.shadows: Soft blob or simple shadow maps.
lighting.atmosphere: Coloured fog, floating motes and god rays as painted cards.
lighting.time_of_day: A day cycle that tints the sky and fog.

world_and_space.scale: Heroic: doors and lanterns 1.3–1.5 times real size.
world_and_space.interiors: Taverns and halls full of barrels, beams and warm lamps.
world_and_space.exteriors: Villages with crooked half-timbered houses, paths and big trees.
world_and_space.threshold: A door opens into a room with no load in later games; a short load in early ones.

principles.rule: Make doors and props 1.3–1.5 times real scale so they read from the camera.
Paint 3 layers: sky light, warm lamps and painted ambient occlusion.
Put a landmark (a tower, a big tree) in every vista.

interface.placement: Ornate frames along the bottom and the corners, 10–20% of the screen.
interface.type_and_icons: Fantasy serif fonts and painted icons.
interface.diegesis: On top, in a fantasy frame.

emotion.target_response: Warm adventure: the viewer sees a cosy, heroic world and wants to step in.

avoid_when: The brief needs a real material sample.

modifiers.how: Add ink outlines and flatten the shade into 2 steps.
Keep the layout; replace painted light with physical materials.
